plugin.name: eis
plugin._long: Runs a compositor-side emulated-input (EIS) server and exports the private org.wayfire.Eis D-Bus interface used by xdg-desktop-portal-wlr to implement the InputCapture portal.

option.name: use_socket_backend
option._long: Expose the EIS server on a unix socket at $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/wayfire-eis so that ei-debug-events can attach. This backend is unauthenticated and intended for debugging only.
